verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe an interactive-comments feature that covers all three parts of the story: tag @cubic-dev-ai or reply to cubic's existing comments to continue the conversation, ask questions, trigger reviews, and fix issues. The quickstart separately documents replying to a review comment to ask for clarification, and the memory docs say replies are remembered. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that in-thread answers are context-aware, and detail on the full command set beyond review and fix.
